verdict.rationale: Fern ships a real CLI (fern-api) that can be installed and run headlessly via npx with no interactive login, as verified by a live probe (npx -y fern-api --version → 5.115.0), and docs describe CLI commands for validating specs, generating SDKs, and publishing docs — all CI-friendly operations. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline guide (e.g., GitHub Actions template) or documented non-interactive auth/token flow for automation in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration examples, headless auth/token setup for automation pipelines, independent confirmation of CI usage at scale.
